items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Order in Council 1271/2024
items.verbatim_snippet: Eric Hanna was appointed Supervisor after a provincially ordered investigation identified concerns encompassing governance, leadership, quality and safety of care, clinical services, operations, financial performance, staffing, and organizational stability.

items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Order in Council 767/2025
items.verbatim_snippet: Order 767/2025 expressly revokes Order 1271/2024, ending Hanna’s appointment on June 8, 2025 and commencing Stumpo’s on June 9, 2025.

items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Order in Council 767/2025
items.verbatim_snippet: Carmine Stumpo was appointed to succeed Eric Hanna and continue carrying out the Supervisor’s duties.
